ref: ADR-0005 division rule; obs-division (#38) records PO's own text for the same inputs
note: The eight lines of obs-division d1 (#38), Qty divided by Sku. A terminating quotient is exact (4/2 is 2, 1/4 is 0.25, 10/4 is 2.5); otherwise the scale is max(18, scale(dividend) - scale(divisor) + 18) and the last digit is rounded half-down (1/3, 2.0/3 to ...667, 7/3, 0.1/3 with 19 digits); 1/30000000000000000000001 rounds to 0.
